<template>
    <div class="border-[var(--color-ink-400)]/40 text-(--color-ink-700) bg-(--color-ink-100)">
                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'border-[var(--color-ink-400)]/40' can be written as 'border-ink-400/40'
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'text-(--color-ink-700)' can be written as 'text-ink-700'
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'bg-(--color-ink-100)' can be written as 'bg-ink-100'
        <p class="ring-(--color-brand-200) divide-(--color-ink-300)">brand</p>
                  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'ring-(--color-brand-200)' can be written as 'ring-brand-200'
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'divide-(--color-ink-300)' can be written as 'divide-ink-300'
        <button
            class="rounded-[var(--radius-sm)] data-[state=open]:text-(--color-ink-1000) px-2 py-2"
                   ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ~~~~ ~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: Classnames 'px-2, py-2' could be replaced by the 'p-2' shorthand!

!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'data-[state=open]:text-(--color-ink-1000)' can be written as 'data-[state=open]:text-ink-1000'
        >
            click
        </button>
        <span class="bg-[var(--color-doesnotexist)]">unknown var stays</span>
                     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: The class 'bg-[var(--color-doesnotexist)]' can be written as 'bg-(--color-doesnotexist)'

</template>
